decision_conditions: The proposed amendments cannot be considered as a non-material change under the provisions of Section 96A of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as the submitted documents indicate a proposed change to the roof tile colour of the extension. This amendment would conflict with Condition 3 of the original permission granted on appeal (ref: APP/R5510/D/23/3317666, dated 23/06/2023). As the change does not comply with this condition, it is considered material and cannot be approved under Section 96A.
description: Non-material amendment to planning permission ref. 39987/APP/2022/1052 (Appeal ref: APP/R5510/D/23/3317666), dated 23-06-23 (Erection of a part first floor rear extension) to allow the use of grey roof tiles in place of the existing red roof tiles
